name: cadsketch
description: Sketch, edit and review flat mechanical parts in CADSketch, right inside Codex.

interface.longDescription: CADSketch is a sketch-first CAD editor: freehand strokes snap to clean, constrained, dimensioned geometry that extrudes to a solid. In Codex it opens from the sidebar or beside a conversation, opens .cadsketch and .dxf files from your workspace, and shares what is on the canvas with the agent so it can draw, review and revise parts with you.
defaultPrompt: Use CADSketch to draw a 60 x 30 mm L-bracket, 5 mm thick, with three M4 holes.
Create bracket.cadsketch for a motor mount and open it in CADSketch.
Review the part I have open in CADSketch for manufacturability.
